CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Complete failure at clinical translation - 0/31 patients achieved complete or partial response across all three dose cohorts. Primary endpoint of tumor response was not met despite confirmed target engagement and pathway modulation. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: ASS-negative tumors showed no improved response vs ASS ≤5% positive, indicating the hypothesized biomarker-defined population did not respond differentially. Some patients achieved stable disease (9/31, 29%) but no objective responses. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This was a dose-escalation Phase I study with adequate sample size (n=31) and appropriate duration (52 weeks). Safety was manageable with 3.2% grade 5 events. The failure appears to be genuine lack of clinical efficacy despite confirmed mechanism of action.
